description: This file defines the TemplateData class, which provides data structures related to templates, including entities and types, used within the Fineract project. It includes methods for creating instances with or without a Template object, and for retrieving entity and type information as lists of maps.

classes.name: TemplateData
classes.description: A utility class that provides template-related data, such as entities and types, in list form, for use within the application.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Factory method that creates a TemplateData instance associated with a specific Template.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Factory method that creates an empty TemplateData instance with no associated Template.

methods.name: getEntites
methods.description: Generates a list of maps, each representing a TemplateEntity with its id and name.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Generates a list of maps, each representing a TemplateType with its id and name.
